raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Follow-up to #62192, addressing yewentao256's review:

- `vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/__init__.py` ("Try combining the code"): the batch-invariant branch now picks the kernel first (Humming for W4A16; otherwise CUTLASS, or emulation where CUTLASS is unsupported) and then emits one shared warning when `--linear-backend` is overridden. Kernel selection is unchanged. The info log "forces NVFP4 linear to use the CUTLASS backend" is dropped, since the forced path already logs `Using <kernel> for NVFP4 GEMM`.
- `tests/kernels/quantization/test_nvfp4_kernel_selection.py` ("This test not needed for this small update"): removed `test_batch_invariant_w4a16_selects_humming`.

## Test

- Ran the removed test once against the new code before deleting it, together with the remaining tests in `test_nvfp4_kernel_selection.py` (CPU): 7 passed.
- `pre-commit` on the changed files passes.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used; I reviewed every changed line.
